name: Helios
source:
An intelligent pixie, who employs his knowledge to navigate tough situations and remain composed for the sake of his team. His concept of love focuses on self-care and appreciation for one's partner.

[From[url=https://deniz-g-lerosi.itch.io/chromatic-agape] itch.io[/url]]
